newsitem.title: UK: Brent Walker sells Pubmaster for 171 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Brent Walker sells Pubmaster for 171 mln stg.

text.p: Debt-laden leisure company Brent Walker Group Plc said on Thursday that it has conditionally agreed to sell its Pubmaster pub chain to Berryboss for 171.3 million stg in cash.
Berryboss is a newly incorporated company set up for the purpose of making the acquisition by a syndicate led by NatWest Ventures.
The syndicate also includes Prudential Ventures, HSBC Holdings and the Bank of Scotland.
Brent Walker said the proceeds of the sale would allow a total of 143.6 million stg of debt to be repaid.
It said that even with the procceds it would still have a deficit on shareholders' funds of in excess of 1.1 billion stg.
